description: This file is a shell script (.sh) containing test cases for Git push options, including repository setup, hook configuration, and various push scenarios. It includes function definitions, command executions, and test assertions related to push options functionality.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories, configures hooks for push options, and sets up remote tracking for testing push scenarios.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares two refs (branches or commits) between upstream and workbench repositories to verify they are identical.

methods.name: mk_http_pair
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP-based Git repository with configurable push option support, clones it for testing push behavior over HTTP.
